subject: Next steps: SIG initiation & clarifying asks after demo
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@carebridge.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: SIG initiation & clarifying asks after demo

Hi Emma — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions so we can kick off the security intake cleanly: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance baseline
- Please confirm whether you have a SOC 2 Type II report available (pdf) and the date range covered. We can accept a redacted copy over SSO-protected SharePoint.

2) Data residency & hosting
- You mentioned primary workload in AWS — can you confirm the primary region (e.g., us-east-1) and whether any EU/APAC tenants exist?

3) Regulatory needs
- Any requirement for a signed BAA? Also confirm HIPAA scope (PHI in our flows) or if you only need GDPR data handling specifics.

4) Questionnaire format
- We usually kick off with the SIG/CAIQ or our short custom intake. To speed things up, I attached a lightweight SIG template and our SOC2 summary. Can you confirm if CareBridge prefers to:  a) fill SIG/CAIQ (we accept JSON export), b) answer a short custom form, or c) have us prefill fields based on our SOC2 artifacts?

5) Timeline & owners
- What turnaround do you expect for questionnaire completion? Also please share procurement contact for contract/BAA (I recall Sara on the call).

Next steps from Redwood: Jordan will coordinate the docs upload link; Karthik will scope evidence owners and start the SIG ticket once you confirm format.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15 min follow up if helpful.

Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0174
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sig-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), SOC2-summary.pdf (one-page summary)

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@carebridge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Procure <sara.procure@carebridge.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T14:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: SIG initiation & clarifying asks after demo

Thanks Sergio — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below: 

- SOC2: We completed SOC 2 Type II in March 2025. I can share a redacted report; procurement prefers it via a secure link.
- Hosting: Primary region is us-east-1. No EU/APAC tenants for this deployment.
- Regulatory: We require a BAA for PHI use cases. Our security team will need to validate controls scoped to HIPAA.
- Questionnaire: CareBridge prefers to upload a CAIQ JSON export if the vendor (you) can accept it — that makes mapping much faster. If Redwood can accept CAIQ JSON, we’ll export and upload.
- Timeline: Procurement typically expects a 7–10 business day turnaround for initial completion, but we can be flexible for priority pieces.

Procurement contact is Sara Procure (cc’d). Please include any evidence checklist you need and an expected SLA for Redwood’s intake.

—Emma
Director, Security & Risk Ops
CareBridge Health
emma.liu@carebridge.com

Thanks — on it. Quick answers: 

1) CAIQ JSON: yes, we can accept CAIQ JSON export. Preferred flow: CareBridge uploads the JSON to the secure ticket (Zendesk) and we run an automated mapper that populates our intake spreadsheet. That reduces manual mapping by ~80%.

2) Evidence SLA: Once JSON + SOC2 report + BAA are received, target 10 business days for initial evidence review and gap call. If any critical gaps appear that affect HIPAA scope, we’ll escalate to Security & Legal.

3) Next steps I’ll take now: 
- Create Zendesk ticket SEC-4571 (sig-initiation-ticket-4571) and enable secure file upload link.
- Attach our BAA template and the intake spreadsheet (redwood-sig-template.xlsx) to the ticket.
- Set internal owners: Karthik (evidence mapping), Security (audit), Jordan (procurement upload instructions).

I’ll reply-all to Emma & Sara once the ticket is live with the upload link and expected review window.

Karthik Iyer
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
